description: Insider transactions at a German listed company (directors' dealings under MAR Article 19, as notified to BaFin): are its managers buying or selling? Issuer-level aggregate over a rolling 12 months: notification counts, gross buy and sell amounts, net flow, breakdown by declarer category, plus the underlying notifications. Query by LEI or ISIN (BaFin publishes no company register number). No individual is ever named, and the breakdown is withheld when it would single someone out. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

depuis.description: Start day (default: rolling 12 months; BaFin keeps 12 months; never earlier than five years back, and periode.depuis_demande says when a request was bounded). Accepts YYYY-MM-DD (a real date), or a full ISO 8601 timestamp (offset Z, ±HH:MM, ±HHMM or none, read as UTC): only its UTC day is kept.

id.description: LEI (20 chars, ISO 17442) or ISIN (12 chars) of the German listed issuer

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_german_insider_transactions

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: German insider transactions
